categories.main_business_segments: Casey's General Stores operates 2,521 convenience stores across 16 states, primarily in Iowa, Missouri, and Illinois. The company operates stores under the Casey's, Casey's General Store, GoodStop, Bucky's, and Minit Mart brands. All stores offer fuel, prepared foods (especially pizza), groceries, beverages, tobacco products, and general merchandise. The company also manages a dealer network of 76 locations where it supplies fuel wholesale.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company operates three distribution centers (in Ankeny Iowa, Terre Haute Indiana, and Joplin Missouri) that supply stores with groceries, merchandise, and prepared food items via company-operated delivery trucks. Nearly all stores feature full kitchens for preparing handmade pizza, donuts, sandwiches, and other prepared foods. The company self-distributes fuel to stores using a fleet of 397 tractors and maintains electronic tank monitoring systems for underground storage tanks.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Casey's serves convenience store customers in smaller communities (approximately 50% of stores in areas with populations under 5,000) as well as larger communities (approximately 26% in areas with populations over 20,000). Primary customer segments include individual consumers purchasing fuel, groceries, prepared foods, and convenience items. The company also serves a dealer network for wholesale fuel supply.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates in 16 states, with primary presence in Iowa, Missouri, and Illinois. Additional operating states include Arkansas, Indiana, Kentucky, Michigan, Minnesota, Nebraska, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Dakota, Tennessee, Wisconsin, and Kansas. The company has three distribution centers strategically located to serve stores within approximately 500 miles of each facility.
categories.supply_chain_position: Casey's operates at the retail/downstream end of the supply chain as a convenience store operator. The company also engages in midstream activities through its wholesale fuel dealer network and distribution operations. The company self-distributes merchandise and fuel to its stores and manages fuel procurement and supply agreements.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities include reinventing hospitality and guest experience, accelerating unit growth through new store construction and acquisitions, creating operational efficiencies, and investing in people and culture. Key initiatives include expanding prepared food offerings (particularly pizza and donuts), growing private label products (over 300 items), developing electric vehicle charging infrastructure (138 stations at 29 stores), expanding renewable fuel options, and enhancing the Casey's Rewards loyalty program (6.4 million members).
categories.revenue_model: Casey's generates revenue primarily through retail sales of fuel (66.4% of total revenue in fiscal 2023), grocery and general merchandise (22.8%), and prepared food and dispensed beverages (8.8%). The company also generates revenue from other sources including lottery, car washes, and wholesale fuel supply to dealers. Revenue is recognized at the point of sale to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The convenience store industry is highly competitive. Casey's competes with other convenience store chains (Quik Trip, Kwik Trip/Star, Kum & Go), supermarkets, drugstores, discount stores, gas stations, quick service restaurants, and online retailers. The company differentiates itself through strong presence in smaller communities, competitive pricing, extended hours, quality prepared food offerings, and loyalty programs. Competitors in larger markets often have greater financial resources and brand recognition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Casey's is a large-cap company with approximately $8.5 billion in market value as of April 30, 2023. Total revenue for fiscal 2023 was $15.1 billion, up 16.5% from prior year. Net income was $446.7 million, up 31.4% from $339.8 million in fiscal 2022. The company has demonstrated consistent growth through store expansion (2,521 stores at year-end, up from 2,452 prior year) and acquisitions. Diluted EPS was $11.91, up 30.8% year-over-year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Casey's differentiates through its focus on smaller communities underserved by national chains, offering broader product selection than typical convenience stores at competitive prices. Key differentiators include handmade pizza (available in 98% of stores), expanded prepared food offerings, private label products, loyalty rewards program, convenient locations with extended hours, and fuel offerings. The company emphasizes quality, value, and community presence as core competitive advantages.
